I have seen his modifications to starship drives and can understand how he caused the explosion which killed the Yagaran Four.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to an entry of a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives dedicated to Maniac|<ref name="CRO" />}}
The '''Yagaran Four''' were a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] team from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Yagara system/Legends|Yagara system]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|drive]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] known as "[[Maniac]]" worked for the team, and he subjected the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of their [[Unidentified YT-1300 light freighter|YT-1300 light freighter]] to a dangerous modification. When the Yagaran Four later activated the hyperdrive during a pursuit of a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] target on the astronomical object [[Elin Roe]], the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|craft]] instead exploded, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the team.

==Description==
The Yagaran Four were a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]<ref name="CRO" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Yagara system/Legends|Yagara system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Hadar sector/Legends|Hadar sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> They made use of a heavily [[Weapon/Legends|armed]] [[Unidentified YT-1300 light freighter|YT-1300 light freighter]] and employed the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] known as "[[Maniac]]," who specialized in work on [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|drive]] systems. The Yagaran Four insisted that Maniac improve the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], and the mechanic indeed performed a modification on it, albeit a dangerous one.<ref name="CRO" />

==History==
At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Yagaran Four pursued a target on which a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] had been posted. During the chase on<ref name="CRO" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC Elin Roe">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Elin Roe system/Legends|Elin Roe system]]</ref> celestial body [[Elin Roe]], the team activated their [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter's]] hyperdrive, which caused the [[Freighter/Legends|starship]] to explode. The bounty [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]], and a [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] dust subsequently washed over [[Elin Roe's fifth moon]]. Maniac himself survived the team's demise. Later, in a personal addendum to an entry dedicated to the Krish that was part of a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing various [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives, Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] noted that the deaths of the Yagaran Four were understandable given Maniac's reckless tendencies.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yagaran Four were created by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and were introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" />
